reason: A Claude subscription login can carry a queue of accounts. The credential file defines account order and login generations; refreshed tokens are authoritative in the engine credential store. Status, the quota dashboard and rotation share the queue, while quota reads reuse inference authentication instead of expired login seeds.

storage.legacyReadsAs: one account with id 'legacy', read without rewriting the file
storage.writeShape: every write replaces the whole accounts array under the shared directory lock

status.currentRule: the head of the queue is isCurrent; exactly one row is current

usage.authentication: the engine reuses each account's refreshed credential namespace and refresh lock; the host never reads login tokens for quota requests
usage.refresh: renew expired tokens before querying and retry an unauthorized usage request once after renewal; queries never advance the account queue
usage.topLevel: the head account's state, windows and plan, for backward-compatible single-account readers
usage.failureIsolation: one account's usage failure reports state 'error' on its own row and never blanks the others
usage.requestPolicy: the host coalesces concurrent reads for the same login queue, caches snapshots briefly, and waits through a bounded cooldown after a usage HTTP 429; login or queue changes invalidate the cache
usage.noAccounts: state 'signed_out' with an empty accounts array

conditionalFields.error: present only on a row whose state is error
conditionalFields.windows: present only on a row whose state is ok

rotation.authentication: renew the current account once before rotating after an authentication failure; single-account and static credentials retain their terminal authentication behavior
rotation.advance: the failed account moves to the tail and the new order is persisted to the credential file
rotation.concurrent: a caller whose failed account is no longer the head retries the current head without advancing again
rotation.cycleEnd: the account that started the cycle failing again ends it; the remaining provider refusal is terminal and a later manual continue starts a fresh cycle
